emails.footer: You are receiving this because you have a GatVuller booking or account.

bookingConfirmed.subject: Confirmed: {title} at {salon}
bookingConfirmed.preheader: Your code is {code}. Show it when you arrive.
bookingConfirmed.title: Your surprise slot is booked
bookingConfirmed.intro: This is your confirmation. Show the code at the desk.
bookingConfirmed.policy: Free cancellation until {hours} hours before the start.
bookingConfirmed.demo: This was a demo payment: nothing was charged.

bookingReceived.subject: New booking: {title} · {time}
bookingReceived.title: New booking
bookingReceived.checkin: Ask for the code and mark the visit in your dashboard.

bookingCancelled.subject: Cancelled: {title} at {salon}
bookingCancelled.title: Booking cancelled
bookingCancelled.expired: Payment was not completed. The slot is free again.
bookingCancelled.refunded: We are refunding {amount}. Card refunds take a few days.

bookingCancelledSalon.subject: Cancellation: {title} · {time}
bookingCancelledSalon.title: A booking was cancelled
bookingCancelledSalon.intro: {customer} will not come for {title}. The slot is open again.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your GatVuller password
passwordReset.title: Choose a new password
passwordReset.intro: Use the button to set a new password. The link works for 1 hour.
passwordReset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

slotAlert.subject: New surprise slot: {title} (−{percent}%)
slotAlert.title: A slot just opened
slotAlert.intro: {salon} posted a last-minute slot that matches your alert.

reviewRequest.subject: How was {salon}?
reviewRequest.title: A one-minute review
reviewRequest.intro: Your visit at {salon} is over. A rating helps the next customer.

welcomeCustomer.subject: Welcome to GatVuller
welcomeCustomer.title: Your account is ready
welcomeCustomer.intro: Find last-minute slots at salons, clinics and more.
welcomeCustomer.steps: Pick a slot, pay, and show your code when you arrive.

welcomeSalon.subject: Welcome, {salon}
welcomeSalon.title: Your salon is on GatVuller
welcomeSalon.intro: Post a surprise slot whenever a gap opens in the diary.
welcomeSalon.steps: Pick a time, the normal price and the surprise price, then publish.
